For each J use F(a,p)=(f(a),p), f identity on a band covering non-adjusted J, f'>0, f'=r at infinities, transitions in adjusted regions. Middle unchanged; transition block K partial_a=(f'/r)R_alpha, K R_alpha=-(r/f')partial_a is compatible; xi block unchanged. At ends K alpha-adjusted. Curves/constraints/negative ends correspond under F^-1; asymptotically affine f preserves finite energy and actions satisfy A^+_(r alpha)=r A^+_alpha. For each datum inf_r=r inf_alpha<=r c_k(alpha). Sup and reverse with1/r give equality, including infinity.

For0<=t<1 use V_t=(1-t)V and uniform Lemma4.4 short-orbit argument. Bound c0,c1 in [(1-δ)T0,(1+δ)T0], δ<1/3; no long orbit and no sum of>=2 positive actions can lie there. q_k(t)=(c_k(beta_t)-tT0)/(1-t) is continuous into fixed Sard-null set T0*S(CritS), hence constant. For fixed smooth S take t<1 close1 so Proposition10.4 applies, then divide by1-t to yield c0(Salpha0)=T0 minS,c1=T0 maxS.

Restrict strict sharpness claims and related arbitrary-systolic-ratio statements to n>=2. Section2's nonempty displaceable open set in C^(n-1) requires positive transverse dimension.
